Claimed 1000 certified, verified 12 active certified (all 12 on the firm's domain, none expired). Verified numbers meet Select (2 joint customers, 1 public story, screening clear, no CRM or channel conflicts), so recommend Select, not Global Premier.

Approved at Registered: Select requires one public customer story and none was provided (the application says "available on request" with no URL). Bench (claimed 10, verified 10 active certified) and joint customers (claimed 2, verified 2, both North America) meet Select, and there are no direct-account conflicts, existing partner accounts, or compliance issues (screening clear). Once a public story naming Lumen & Lattice and Claude is live, the firm qualifies for Select at the 2027-01-01 promotion.
